facts.text: Gannon University launched Project NePTWNE, a $24 million environmental sustainability initiative focused on water quality and microplastics in Lake Erie.

sources.title: Protect What Matters Most - Gannon Magazine Online Edition
sources.quote: Project NePTWNE, which is short for Nano & Polymer Technology for Water and Neural-networks in Erie, is Gannon's $24 million initiative toward environmental sustainability.
